title: Nvidia's CEO Quit, Then Came Back in 11 Days
sources: ABC News (Reuters/AFP), 24 Nov 2026: Huang departed Nov 12; reinstated effective immediately; affairs reports incl. a businesswoman US authorities suspected of spying for China; Beijing denied the spying allegations; petition for reinstatement passed 180,000 signatures

Yahoo Finance / BeInCrypto, 23 Nov 2026: CFO Colette Kress interim CEO since Nov 12; on the Nov 17 earnings call the board chair said the board 'does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO'; reinstated Monday, 11 days after resigning; board got input from senior levels of the US government and is confident his return 'poses no national security risk'
Motley Fool, 23 Nov 2026: Nvidia surged about 31% on Nov 23, adding nearly $1 trillion in market value
Tom's Hardware, 23 Nov 2026: unanimous board vote; stock fell during the 11-day exit

lines.text: In just eleven days, Nvidia's CEO quit and came back.

lines.text: On November twelfth, Jensen Huang resigned,
after a scandal and alleged spy ties, which China denied.
The board said he was not coming back,
But a hundred eighty thousand people petitioned for him.
Then U.S. officials said he was no security risk,
lines.caps: Then | U.S. | officials | said | he was | no | security | risk,

lines.text: so the board voted him back in.
And the stock jumped thirty-one percent in one day!
